media.alt: Taupe desk pad and notepad holder with a cognac tray on a walnut desk.

title.html: Every detail belongs to the experience.

body.html: A material board establishes a direction; a product brief makes it actionable. Add available surface dimensions, use and quantities to colour and finish references. This separates open design questions from fixed technical constraints. Samples and artwork bring the two together in a specification that can be reviewed.

A successful interior depends on considered proportions and materials. Small functional objects can reinforce that coherence. We translate moodboards, material samples and sketches into proposals for leather and wood accessories, shaped around the furniture, intended use and brand identity.

title.html: From design intent to a reviewable specification

body.html: Custom dimensions, shapes and compartments are developed entirely around your design and requirements. Technical layouts clarify the details; a physical sample makes scale and tactility tangible. Fine genuine Italian leather, high-quality PU in an extensive range of colours and finishes, and other appropriate materials are considered against your scheme. The agreed accessories are handmade in the EU.

Dimensioned surfaces, relevant furniture elevations, colour references, logo artwork and quantities per item give us a useful starting point. Tell us which details are essential and where there is room to explore. This makes open questions visible early and allows meaningful comparison between specifications.
Desk pads and notepad holders for suites, workspaces and meeting tables. Developed as a coordinated collection of formats, materials and branding.
